prompt: What is the period of $y = \tan x$?
hint: Tangent is not like sine and cosine — it repeats twice as often.

hints.text: Tangent is not like sine and cosine — it repeats twice as often.
Tangent repeats every $180^\circ$, that is, every $\pi$ radians.

explanation: Tangent is $\frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta}$, and adding $\pi$ flips the sign of BOTH the sine and the cosine.
Two sign flips cancel in a quotient, so $\tan(\theta + \pi) = \tan\theta$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Think about slope
steps: $\tan\theta$ is the slope of the line through the origin at angle $\theta$.
Turn that line a half-turn and you get the very same line, with the very same slope.
A half-turn is $\pi$, so tangent repeats every $\pi$.
